briefing: Commander, a prototype hull was stolen from a Navy yard, and command wants it destroyed, not recovered.
Accept the contract and you receive its last known position, then report to any station for further orders.
dossier.lead: A fresh Navy transmission awaits her attention.

hunt.arrive: Find and destroy the Constrictor last seen at {TARGET}
hunt.success: The Constrictor is destroyed and {PAY} is confirmed
hunt.fail: The Constrictor escaped and the operation failed

report.arrive: Dock at any station and await further orders
report.success: Contact made, the plans are ready for courier
report.fail: Contact lost and command lost patience

courier.success: The plans are delivered and {PAY} is paid in full
courier.fail: The plans never arrived and the mission failed

dossier.news: The news wire carries a fresh Navy alert about the stolen prototype hull.

rumour.far: Dock talk says the Navy wants a stolen prototype hunted down.
rumour.near: A tight-band Navy signal warns that the stolen hull must be destroyed, not boarded.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, she accepted a Navy order to hunt down a stolen prototype hull.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the Constrictor was scrapped and the Navy's plans reached {WORLD}.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the hunt for the Constrictor collapsed, and the trail went cold near {WORLD}.

hunt.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the Constrictor was destroyed at {WORLD}.
hunt.failed: On day {DAY}, the Constrictor slipped away near {WORLD}.

report.success: On day {DAY}, she reported the kill at {WORLD} for new orders.
report.failed: On day {DAY}, she failed to reach {WORLD} in time to report.

courier.success: On day {DAY}, she delivered the Navy's plans to {WORLD}.
courier.failed: On day {DAY}, the Navy's plans never reached {WORLD}.

dossier.title: The Constrictor Directive
